measurementDefinitions.loadeddata: Event-only, navigation timestamp and relative native play timestamp; may preload before play; not a presented frame
measurementDefinitions.firstPresentedFrame: Actual requestVideoFrameCallback metadata, positive dimensions/mediaTime; no loadeddata fallback
measurementDefinitions.seek: Actual native button initiated currentTime seek plus seeked and post-seek frame/progress; not native scrubber dragging
measurementDefinitions.waiting: Observed waiting events paired to resume/pause/seek/end; durations and ratio to defined scripted window, startup/seek included
measurementDefinitions.stalled: Network stalled event counts are separate and do not prove playback stopped
measurementDefinitions.percentiles: One component sample; population P95 unavailable
measurementDefinitions.httpBytes: Stream bytes queued, not TCP/browser acknowledgements
